init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for SLURM multi-node multi-GPU jobs using params object
init_signal_handler: install SLURM signal handlers for job pre-emption and time limit SIGUSR1 signals
sig_handler: handle SLURM SIGUSR1 signal to requeue the job on the master process and exit
term_handler: handle SIGTERM signal by logging and bypassing termination for graceful SLURM shutdown
review_slurm_module: review the slurm module functions for SLURM job signal handling and distributed mode initialization
